text: The purpose of this report is to advise Toronto City Council, pursuant to Chapter 195 of the Toronto Municipal Code (Purchasing By-law, Section 195-7.4), of an amendment to Purchase Order Number 6050742, issued to CIMA Canada Inc. (CIMA+), for additional contract administration related to emergency repairs to raw water valves at F. J. Horgan Treatment Plant in amount of $530,503 net of all taxes and charges ($539,840 net of HST recoveries), revising the current Purchase Order value from $536,514 net of all taxes and charges ($545,957 net of HST recoveries) to $1,067,017 net of all taxes and charges ($1,085,796 net of HST recoveries). In addition, this report advises of an amendment to Purchase Order Number 6053360, issued to WSN Construction Inc.
